trust_decision.summary: DataHandler.verify_security decides whether a DTD/XSD URL taken from parsed XML may be fetched (https + NCBI host); a sticky instance flag self.secure, set after the first passing URL, makes every later check on that handler a no-op, including the unrelated xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation route.

landing_point.why: The summary names doctype XXE via Bio.Entrez; externalEntityRefHandler is the DTD/external-entity resolver, and verify_security sits next to it at Bio/Entrez/Parser.py:1084.

fix_sites.module_kind: core parser state (sticky trust flag replaced by bypass_url_security)

fix_sites.entry_point: Bio.Entrez.read / Bio.Entrez.parse -> externalEntityRefHandler and schemaHandler -> verify_security
Bio.Entrez.read / Bio.Entrez.parse -> expat ExternalEntityRefHandler (DOCTYPE system id and nested DTD/.mod references)
fix_sites.module_kind: core parser, external entity resolver (check moved before dtd_urls push, push/pop wrapped in try/finally)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All changed sites are in Bio/Entrez/Parser.py. The second expat DTD/XSD loader, Bio/Blast/_parser.py:75-88 and :1152-1168, uses only bundled local files after an allowlist and never fetches URLs, so it is not an unprotected route.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The schemaLocation route (Bio/Entrez/Parser.py:569) already calls verify_security, so a solver who fixes only the DOCTYPE/external-entity path can argue that the schema path is "already checked" and miss that the DTD route's sticky self.secure state turns that check into a no-op.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Nested DTD/.mod references from a trusted NCBI DTD must still resolve: relative system ids are joined to the parent URL, and the fix deliberately trusts children of a trusted parent even on other hosts. Bundled and cached local DTDs/XSDs are looked up by basename before any network fetch. A fix that pins every URL to the three-host list, or drops the per-depth trust, can break real NCBI DTD chains.

O6_input_shapes: absolute https DOCTYPE system id to an NCBI host
relative system id resolved against parent dtd_urls[-1] or the default NCBI base
nested external parameter entities (.mod files) at depth > 0 (verify_hostname=False)
xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation XSD URL after a DTD has already been trusted (the regression test case)
hostname suffix generalised from a three-name allowlist to *.nlm.nih.gov

O7_producer.where: Bio/Entrez/Parser.py:1058-1082 (save_dtd_file / save_xsd_file write fetched bytes under basename only; open_dtd_file / open_xsd_file at Bio/Entrez/Parser.py:1020-1056 read them back by basename, ignoring the host)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a schema <xs:include>/<xs:import> follower inside schemaHandler/parse_xsd that fetches schemaLocation by urlopen without verify_security
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Bio/Blast/_parser.py:113-120 already follows xs:include schemaLocation for the BLAST XSD, so a maintainer porting that to Entrez for multi-file NCBI schemas would plausibly copy it without the URL check.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: cache lookup keyed by basename only, so content fetched from any host is reused for a trusted URL with the same filename on a later parse
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The cache already ignores the host; that is a HOW-type sibling across a save/reload boundary that the check never touches.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a network fallback in the BLAST XML DTD handler when the DTD is not bundled
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Entrez's resolver has exactly this fallback (Bio/Entrez/Parser.py:1133-1143); a second implementation in another package reaching urlopen would be missed at that distance.

O9_family: XXE / untrusted external DTD/XSD URL fetch (CWE-611): trust state leaks across checks

O10_build.language: Python (with C extensions elsewhere in Biopython)
O10_build.project_tests: Tests/test_Entrez_parser.py (offline, uses bundled DTDs in Bio/Entrez/DTDs and XSDs in Bio/Entrez/XSDs); the fix adds UrlSecurityCheckTest using Mock on verify_security (fix.diff:155-194)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Delete the self.secure = True line so every URL is checked against the fixed three-host list. That closes the leak but rejects legitimate nested DTDs from other hosts, and leaves the try/finally pop ordering untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: Post-fix verify_security calls hostname.endswith on urlparse(url).hostname, which can be None (for example https:///x) and then raises AttributeError, not ValueError; this is not a bypass.
Other Bio XML readers (Bio/SeqIO/UniprotIO.py:61, Bio/Phylo/PhyloXMLIO.py:277, Bio/motifs/xms.py:103, Bio/Blast/NCBIXML.py:609-616) use stdlib parsers with no network DTD fetch; not pursued.
